subject: general
question: Find the area of a sector with a central angle of 150° in a circle with a radius of 12 cm.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Area of sector** = (θ ÷ 360) × πr²

Given: θ = 150° and r = 12 cm

**Area** = (150 ÷ 360) × π × 12 × 12

**Area** = (5 ÷ 12) × 144π = 5 × 12π = 60π

**∴ The correct answer is 60π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Central angle** (θ) = 150°

**Radius** (r) = 12 cm

**Formula Used:**

Area of a sector = (θ ÷ 360°) × πr²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56323733f752619ed39fb03046af90131f8f94f633c174723af7f4120d3d0db0.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area = (150° ÷ 360°) × π × (12)²

⇒ Area = (5 ÷ 12) × π × 144

⇒ Area = 5 × π × (144 ÷ 12)

⇒ Area = 5 × 12π

⇒ Area = 60π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 60π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Length of an Arc

The distance along the curved line of the sector is given by l = (θ ÷ 360) × 2πr.

Area in terms of Arc Length

The area of a sector can also be calculated as Area = (1 ÷ 2) × l × r, where l is the arc length.

Perimeter of a Sector

The total boundary of the sector includes the arc and two radii: Perimeter = l + 2r.</p
